title: Week 9 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “bureaucracy”?
options: The organizations and officials that administer laws and public programs.
A person who organizes resources, bears uncertainty, and develops products, services, or processes.
Responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in price.
The agreement creating proportional representation in the House and equal state representation in the Senate.
questions.explanation: Bureaucracy means the organizations and officials that administer laws and public programs.
choices: The organizations and officials that administer laws and public programs.
A person who organizes resources, bears uncertainty, and develops products, services, or processes.
Responsiveness of quantity demanded to a change in price.
The agreement creating proportional representation in the House and equal state representation in the Senate.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “delegation”?
options: Presidential rejection of legislation, subject to possible congressional override.
A judicial authorization to search a specified place or person for described evidence.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
Comparison of the additional benefit and additional cost of one more unit or action.
questions.explanation: Delegation means a legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
choices: Presidential rejection of legislation, subject to possible congressional override.
A judicial authorization to search a specified place or person for described evidence.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
Comparison of the additional benefit and additional cost of one more unit or action.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “rulemaking”?
options: The process by which issues gain or lose public and governmental attention.
A market in which one firm supplies a product without close substitutes and entry is blocked.
An organization seeking to influence government by electing candidates and coordinating public policy.
The process by which agencies create regulations under statutory authority.
questions.explanation: Rulemaking means the process by which agencies create regulations under statutory authority.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “regulation”?
options: A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.
The court’s authoritative resolution of the legal issue necessary to decide the case.
A rule that government generally may regulate expression without favoring or suppressing a viewpoint.
A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.
questions.explanation: Regulation means a legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.
choices: A significant, broad decline in economic activity lasting more than a brief fluctuation.

A legally binding rule governing conduct within an agency’s authority.

A professional public workforce selected and managed through established personnel systems.
A good that is difficult to exclude people from and can be used without substantially reducing availability to others.
The price of one currency in terms of another.
questions.explanation: Civil service means a professional public workforce selected and managed through established personnel systems.

The judgment officials use when law leaves choices about implementation.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 9 inquiry?
options: A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
A student verifies that an agency action falls within delegated authority and evaluates the evidence and procedure used.
A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
questions.explanation: A student verifies that an agency action falls within delegated authority and evaluates the evidence and procedure used.
